+    main()

+
+class DriveFirmwareTest(ModuleTestCase):
+    def setUp(self):
+        super(DriveFirmwareTest, self).setUp()
+        set_module_args(dict(api_username='admin', api_password='secret', api_url='http://localhost/devmgr/v2',
+                             ssid='1', firmware=['/tmp/update.dlp']))
+        self.manager = NetAppESeriesDriveFirmware()
+
+    def test_upgrade_list_selects_only_needed_accessible_drives(self):
+        compatibility = [{'filename': 'update.dlp', 'firmwareVersion': 'NEW',
+                          'driveRefList': ['one', 'two', 'three']},
+                         {'filename': 'other.dlp', 'firmwareVersion': 'NEW', 'driveRefList': ['four']}]
+        drives = [{'driveRef': 'one', 'firmwareVersion': 'OLD', 'status': 'optimal'},
+                  {'driveRef': 'two', 'firmwareVersion': 'NEW', 'status': 'optimal'},
+                  {'driveRef': 'three', 'firmwareVersion': 'OLD', 'status': 'offline'}]
+        self.manager.ignore_inaccessible_drives = True
+        with mock.patch.object(self.manager, 'request', side_effect=[(200, compatibility), (200, drives)]):
+            self.assertEqual(self.manager.upgrade_list(), [{'filename': 'update.dlp', 'driveRefList': ['one']}])
+            self.assertEqual(self.manager.upgrade_list(), [{'filename': 'update.dlp', 'driveRefList': ['one']}])
+
+    def test_inaccessible_drive_fails_by_default(self):
+        with mock.patch.object(self.manager, 'request', side_effect=[
+                (200, [{'filename': 'update.dlp', 'firmwareVersion': 'NEW', 'driveRefList': ['one']}]),
+                (200, [{'driveRef': 'one', 'firmwareVersion': 'OLD', 'status': 'offline'}])]):
+            with self.assertRaises(AnsibleFailJson):
+                self.manager.upgrade_list()
+
+    def test_wait_ignores_unrelated_drives(self):
+        self.manager._upgrade_list = [{'filename': 'update.dlp', 'driveRefList': ['one']}]
+        self.manager.upgrade_in_progress = True
+        with mock.patch.object(self.manager, 'request', side_effect=[
+                (200, [{'driveRef': 'other', 'status': 'failed'}, {'driveRef': 'one', 'status': 'pending'}]),
+                (200, [{'driveRef': 'one', 'status': 'okay'}])]):
+            with mock.patch('ansible.modules.storage.netapp.netapp_e_drive_firmware.time.sleep'):
+                self.manager.wait_for_upgrade_completion()
+        self.assertFalse(self.manager.upgrade_in_progress)
+
+    def test_check_mode_reports_change_without_upgrade(self):
+        self.manager.module.check_mode = True
+        self.manager._upgrade_list = [{'filename': 'update.dlp', 'driveRefList': ['one']}]
+        with mock.patch.object(self.manager, 'upload_firmware'):
+            with mock.patch.object(self.manager, 'upgrade') as upgrade:
+                with self.assertRaises(AnsibleExitJson) as result:
+                    self.manager.apply()
+        self.assertTrue(result.exception.args[0]['changed'])
+        self.assertFalse(result.exception.args[0]['upgrade_in_process'])
+        upgrade.assert_not_called()
+
+    def test_online_upgrade_rejects_incapable_drive(self):
+        with mock.patch.object(self.manager, 'request', side_effect=[
+                (200, [{'filename': 'update.dlp', 'firmwareVersion': 'NEW', 'driveRefList': ['one']}]),
+                (200, [{'driveRef': 'one', 'firmwareVersion': 'OLD', 'status': 'optimal',
+                        'onlineUpgradeCapable': False}])]):
+            with self.assertRaises(AnsibleFailJson) as failure:
+                self.manager.upgrade_list()
+        self.assertIn('Drive is not capable of online upgrade.', failure.exception.args[0]['msg'])
+
+    def test_upload_error_identifies_file_and_array(self):
+        with mock.patch('ansible.modules.storage.netapp.netapp_e_drive_firmware.create_multipart_formdata',
+                        side_effect=IOError('missing file')):
+            with self.assertRaises(AnsibleFailJson) as failure:
+                self.manager.upload_firmware()
+        self.assertIn('Failed to upload drive firmware', failure.exception.args[0]['msg'])
+        self.assertIn('/tmp/update.dlp', failure.exception.args[0]['msg'])
+        self.assertIn('array [1]', failure.exception.args[0]['msg'])
+
+    def test_upgrade_sets_pending_result(self):
+        self.manager._upgrade_list = [{'filename': 'update.dlp', 'driveRefList': ['one']}]
+        with mock.patch.object(self.manager, 'request', return_value=(202, None)) as request:
+            self.manager.upgrade()
+        self.assertTrue(self.manager.upgrade_in_progress)
+        self.assertEqual(request.call_args[1]['data']['onlineUpgrade'], True)
+
+    def test_wait_rejects_failed_target(self):
+        self.manager._upgrade_list = [{'filename': 'update.dlp', 'driveRefList': ['one']}]
+        with mock.patch.object(self.manager, 'request', return_value=(200, [{'driveRef': 'one', 'status': 'failed'}])):
+            with self.assertRaises(AnsibleFailJson) as failure:
+                self.manager.wait_for_upgrade_completion()
+        self.assertIn('Drive firmware upgrade failed.', failure.exception.args[0]['msg'])

+                    capable = ref_item.get('onlineUpgradeCapable', capable)
+                if self.upgrade_drives_online and not capable:
+                    self.module.fail_json(msg='Drive is not capable of online upgrade. Drive [%s], array [%s].' %
+                                              (ref, self.ssid))
+                selected.setdefault(filename, []).append(ref)
+        self._upgrade_list = [{'filename': name, 'driveRefList': list(dict.fromkeys(refs))}
+                              for name, refs in selected.items()]
+        return self._upgrade_list
+
+    def wait_for_upgrade_completion(self):
+        targets = set(ref for item in self.upgrade_list() for ref in item['driveRefList'])
+        deadline = time.time() + self.WAIT_TIMEOUT_SEC
+        while targets:
+            try:
+                _, response = self.request('storage-systems/%s/firmware/drives/state' % self.ssid)
+                states = self._items(response)
+                if not isinstance(response, (dict, list)):
+                    raise ValueError('Unexpected drive-state response')
+            except Exception as error:
+                self.module.fail_json(msg='Failed to retrieve drive status. Array [%s]: %s' %
+                                          (self.ssid, to_native(error)))
+            for state in states:
+                if not isinstance(state, dict):
+                    continue
+                ref = state.get('driveRef', state.get('id'))
+                if ref not in targets:
+                    continue
+                status = state.get('status')
+                if status == 'okay':
+                    targets.remove(ref)
+                elif status not in self.IN_PROGRESS_STATUSES:
+                    self.module.fail_json(msg='Drive firmware upgrade failed. Drive [%s], status [%s].' %
+                                              (ref, status))
+            if not targets:
+                break
+            if time.time() >= deadline:
+                self.module.fail_json(msg='Timed out waiting for drive firmware upgrade. Array [%s], drives [%s].' %
+                                          (self.ssid, ', '.join(sorted(targets))))
+            time.sleep(self.POLL_INTERVAL_SEC)
+        self.upgrade_in_progress = False
+
+    def upgrade(self):
+        upgrades = self.upgrade_list()
+        if not upgrades:
+            return
+        try:
+            self.request('storage-systems/%s/firmware/drives/initiate-upgrade' % self.ssid,
+                         method='POST', data=dict(onlineUpgrade=self.upgrade_drives_online,
+                                                  firmware=upgrades))
+        except Exception as error:
+            self.module.fail_json(msg='Failed to upgrade drive firmware. Array [%s]: %s' %
+                                      (self.ssid, to_native(error)))
+        self.upgrade_in_progress = True
+        if self.wait_for_completion:
+            self.wait_for_upgrade_completion()
+
+    def apply(self):
+        self.upload_firmware()
+        upgrades = self.upgrade_list()
+        if upgrades and not self.module.check_mode:
+            self.upgrade()
+        self.module.exit_json(changed=bool(upgrades), upgrade_in_process=self.upgrade_in_progress)
+
+
+def main():
+    NetAppESeriesDriveFirmware().apply()
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()
